facts.fact: Night before ch 2: the langurs' silence at dusk made Neela judge a night run too risky with strangers on the road, so she kept both remaining smears and did not turn. Corrects the reading of F451 for that night; the first smear is still unspent and the plan to spend it is deferred.
Neela deliberately takes the west stair into the hall in ch 2, reversing her habit of avoiding it (F449), so Rema will not notice which stair she uses.

First Guard's wrist mark is a single smooth, flat seam about a finger long, unlike Neela's thick layered ridges, and her throat is bare of scars; Devan reasonably reads it as a lamp-burn or rope burn. Refines F454.
